title: Design, synthesis, and biological evaluation of selective estrogen receptor modulators (SERMs) as anticancer agents for ER-positive breast cancer.
authors: Saini, Anurag; Mythri, C; Kalita, Ripunjay; Singh, Agnikula Kshatriya Parvathi; Jat, Sandeep; Kumar, Pramod; Selvaraju, Sudhagar; Sethi, Kalyan Kumar
one_liner_zh: 该研究设计合成SERM类抗癌化合物并评估其对ER+乳腺癌的活性，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Globally, breast cancer stands as one of the primary causes of cancer related deaths. Among the types of breast cancer, estrogen receptor- positive (ER+) breast cancer accounts for the highest incidence and mortality worldwide. The present study emphasizes the design, synthesis, and biological evaluation of a series of novel triphenylethylene (TPE) based selective estrogen receptor modulators (SERMs) for their antiproliferative activity against ER+ breast cancer. All the synthesized compounds were well characterized using spectroscopic and chromatographic techniques. Favorable druglike properties indicating acceptable permeability through membrane and oral bioavailability were observed in in-silico physicochemical, ADME, and toxicity profiling. Further, biological evaluation of the synthesized compounds against MCF-7 breast cancer cells demonstrated significant antiproliferative nature of the synthesized compounds. Compounds 5g and 5o showed antiproliferative activity comparable to the standard metabolite 4-hydroxytamoxifen (4-OH TAM) and the IC(50) of compounds 5g and 5o were found to be 4.350 +/- 0.373 and 3.562 +/- 0.466 muM respectively. Subsequently, the cell death pathway was revealed through caspase-3/7 assay and immunoblotting analysis and the compounds were found to cause cell death through activation of apoptosis-related proteins such as cleaved PARP and cleaved caspase-7. The molecular docking studies on the target protein ERalpha (PDB ID: 3ERT) exhibited favorable docking interactions between the compounds 5g and 5o with key amino acid residues such as Asp351, Thr347, Leu346, and His524. Similar interactions with amino acid residues were observed in the case of 4-OH TAM. Comprehensively, the results of the study highlight the promising anticancer potential of the synthesized compounds 5g and 5o as TPE-based SERM for selective ER+ breast cancer.
abstract_zh: 全球范围内，乳腺癌是癌症相关死亡的主要原因之一。在乳腺癌类型中，雌激素受体阳性（ER+）乳腺癌在全球发病率和死亡率中占比最高。本研究重点在于设计、合成及生物学评价一系列基于三苯乙烯（TPE）的选择性雌激素受体调节剂（SERMs），以评估其对ER+乳腺癌的抗增殖活性。所有合成化合物均通过光谱和色谱技术进行了充分表征。在计算机模拟的理化性质、ADME和毒性分析中，观察到有利的药物样特性，表明其具有可接受的膜通透性和口服生物利用度。进一步，对合成化合物针对MCF-7乳腺癌细胞的生物学评价显示，这些化合物具有显著的抗增殖特性。化合物5g和5o表现出与标准代谢物4-羟基他莫昔芬（4-OH TAM）相当的抗增殖活性，且化合物5g和5o的IC(50)值分别为4.350 ± 0.373和3.562 ± 0.466 μM。随后，通过caspase-3/7实验和免疫印迹分析揭示了细胞死亡途径，发现这些化合物通过激活凋亡相关蛋白（如cleaved PARP和cleaved caspase-7）诱导细胞死亡。针对靶蛋白ERα（PDB ID: 3ERT）的分子对接研究显示，化合物5g和5o与关键氨基酸残基（如Asp351、Thr347、Leu346和His524）之间存在有利的对接相互作用。在4-OH TAM的情况下也观察到与氨基酸残基的类似相互作用。综合来看，研究结果突显了合成化合物5g和5o作为基于TPE的SERM在选择性治疗ER+乳腺癌方面的潜在抗癌前景。
